Your duties may include:

  • Providing one-to-one support for pupils who require additional assistance
  • Working with small groups to improve learning outcomes
  • Supporting children with Special Educational Needs (SEN)
  • Assisting with classroom management and behaviour support
  • Helping to create a positive, inclusive, and engaging learning environment
  • Monitoring and reporting on pupil progress
Teaching Assistant Requirements

To be considered for these Teaching Assistant jobs in Wakefield, you should have:

  • A Level 2 Teaching Assistant qualification, Level 3 Teaching Assistant qualification, or equivalent
  • Previous experience working in a UK primary school
  • Experience supporting children across EYFS, KS1, or KS2
  • A passion for helping children achieve their full potential
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • An Enhanced DBS on the Update Service or willingness to obtain one
